build.name: compile cJSON + Techne's parse-all driver under AddressSanitizer
build.cmd: gcc -O1 -g -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -I. -o $BODY/build/parse_all cJSON.c $HARNESS/parse_all.c 2>&1 | grep -iE '\berror' | head -3; test -x $BODY/build/parse_all && echo built

runs.name: ADVERSARIAL: 200 radamsa-mutated cases; every one must parse or be rejected, none may crash (ASan/UBSan)

notes: PAIR half 2 (response). Cases are the tracked output of radamsa-0.6 (seed 1). A crash would appear as an ASan report and a non-zero exit.
